comparison.objective: Install a comb busbar across three breaker terminals; candidate separates finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-pin simultaneous alignment followed by repeated screw tightening versus bimanual pouring, screen agitation, and particle reorientation.
comparison.success_condition: All pins seated and clamped, pull test passed, tools and hands clear for 2 s versus mass recovery, complete workpiece retention, and loss-free released dwell.
comparison.reason: Multi-point electrical assembly does not measure granular separation or bridge clearing.
